name: motion-after-shake
title: After Shake
description: Bị va từ bên trái, khối rung ngang theo hình sin tắt nhanh rồi đứng yên, có tia sáng nhỏ ở chỗ va.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: On impact (a ball hits from the left): x offset = 20·e^(−6 t)·sin(2π t / 0.2) px, t in s after the hit (5 Hz; actual peaks +15 / −8.3 / +4.5 / −2.5 px at 44 / 144 / 244 / 344 ms; the recipe labels read +20 → −16 → +11), under 0.5 px from ~620 ms; one axis, no rotation, no y. A small star flash at the contact for 140 ms. The same mode serves error shakes and bell rings (rotation, pivot top). Params: amp: biên độ (20 px) · freq: tần số (5 Hz) · decay (6 /s) · axis (x). x = amp × e^(−decay t) × sin(2π freq t): peaks about +0.75, −0.42, +0.22 of amp; one axis, no rotation.
